review.notes: Full review at 5108929 (folder unchanged since the previous review). Gate rerun with --base origin/main: every scanner 0, OK, exit 0. Depcheck: 237 roadmaps, 2341 edges, 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with two sorry warnings; #check of all four declarations matches the README; one-tactic probe closes nothing. Seeded sample: all 13 targets (0.1-7.3) checked against the cached texts (Huybrechts draft and v1, Martin v3, Rudakov-Safarevic 1976, Liedtke, Gounelas-Liedtke, Artebani-Sarti-Taki, Gritsenko-Hulek, Dolgachev, Shen, Stacks 09NU and 02UP); one locator range is off (R04). R01 (P1): the IntegralLattices revision merged to main deletes 5E/5H and moves Nikulin's surjectivity theorems to an unwritten IntegralLatticesPartII that would come after this roadmap, so the O(S)->O(q_S) surjectivity used in section 7.3 has no supplier. R02 (P2): (U) and the rank-22 theorem elaborate at the pins (Mathlib rational maps, Tau Ceti LineBundleClass) but are absent from Suggested.lean and its docstring. R03 (P3): previous R01 carried, K3SurfacesAndSymplecticBoundedness still at c1d6da0. Adversarial table with computed values covers the sample, the headlines and every finding target. Three source issues recorded.
